description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 22.08.2016 to 28.08.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters related to customs operations.
